tables.name: events

constraints.name: events_fact_identity
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_key IS NULL OR COALESCE(wikidata_id IS NULL AND source_key = ((((('fact:'::text || (wikidata_source ->> 'qid'::text)) || ':'::text) || (wikidata_source ->> 'property'::text)) || ':'::text) || lower(wikidata_source ->> 'statementId'::text)) AND (wikidata_source ->> 'qid'::text) ~ '^Q[1-9][0-9]*$'::text AND (wikidata_source ->> 'property'::text) ~ '^P[1-9][0-9]*$'::text AND length(source_key) <= 200, false))

constraints.name: events_wikipedia_titles
constraints.definition: CHECK ((wikipedia_title_fr IS NULL OR char_length(wikipedia_title_fr) >= 1 AND char_length(wikipedia_title_fr) <= 255 AND wikipedia_title_fr = btrim(wikipedia_title_fr) AND wikipedia_title_fr !~ '[][#<>|{}_[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (wikipedia_title_en IS NULL OR char_length(wikipedia_title_en) >= 1 AND char_length(wikipedia_title_en) <= 255 AND wikipedia_title_en = btrim(wikipedia_title_en) AND wikipedia_title_en !~ '[][#<>|{}_[:cntrl:]]'::text))

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_source_key_unique ON public.events USING btree (source_key) WHERE (source_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_date_years_bp ON public.events USING btree (date_years_bp DESC NULLS LAST)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER guard_event_write BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalogue_private.guard_record_write('event')
CREATE TRIGGER track_event_creator AFTER INSERT OR DELETE ON events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalogue_private.track_record_creator('event')
CREATE TRIGGER track_event_creator_id AFTER UPDATE OF id ON events FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.id::text IS DISTINCT FROM new.id::text) EXECUTE FUNCTION catalogue_private.track_record_creator('event')
CREATE TRIGGER trg_events_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
